title: Gradually Done
subtitle: 气候变化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）
meta: 主题语境：气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）　|　核心词汇：gradually　|　正文 324 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gradually 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Gradually, in 1963 the father changed the chair at the door, and everybody in the house said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: before the September rains the father had ② gradually changed the chair, and nobody had asked a single question. The father had come to the house two months earlier, and spoke little of the house he had left behind him.

The letter for September 1957 puts it plainer. The chair was ③ gradually weak, and the neighbour who kept it had ④ gradually carried it twice before the winter came; nothing in the house was ever done gradually in those days. The neighbour wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant something else. He changed the chair ⑤ more gradually than anybody else in the house, and of all who changed it that month he changed it ⑥ the most gradually of all of them. He was not a man who explained himself, and the house had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1970 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the letter. What the line asked for was that the chair be carried ⑦ gradually every month, and that whoever did it be ⑧ gradually careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done gradually.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1973 she changed the chair ⑨ gradually on the same day when nobody else would, and ⑩ Gradually, she said in 1975, that was the part the house never forgot; the letter still speaks gradually of it. She kept the chair in the same door for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the house never forgot how gradually it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 逐渐地（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had gradually changed …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 逐渐地（修饰形容词：gradually weak）
C. adv. 渐渐（评注性状语，置于句首：Gradually, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 渐渐（修饰过去分词：had gradually carried it）
E. adv. 逐渐地（比较级 more gradually than：拿叔叔跟老屋里其他人相比）
F. adv. 逐渐地（最高级 the most gradually of all of them：那个月份所有人之中的比较）
G. adv. 渐渐（被动结构中的中位状语：be carried gradually）
H. adv. 渐渐（修饰形容词：be gradually careful about the whole business）

answers.why: gradually 意为“逐渐地”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Gradually, in 1963 …。
gradually 意为“逐渐地”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had gradually changed the chair。
gradually 意为“逐渐地”，此处修饰形容词 weak（虚弱）：was gradually weak。
gradually 意为“渐渐”，此处修饰过去分词 carried：had gradually carried it twice。
gradually 意为“逐渐地”，拿叔叔跟老屋里所有人相比，故用比较级 more gradually than。
gradually 意为“逐渐地”，那个月份里所有人当中他做得最甚，故用最高级 the most gradually of all of them。
gradually 意为“渐渐”，被动结构 be carried gradually 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
gradually 意为“渐渐”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be gradually careful about the whole business。
gradually 意为“逐渐地”，1973 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次改变那件小小的板凳，副词置于动词之后。
gradually 意为“渐渐”，母亲 1975 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Gradually, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，父亲渐渐在门口改变那件小小的板凳；老屋里人人都说那是头一回。（Gradually, …）
雨季到来之前，父亲已经逐渐地改变那件小小的板凳。（had gradually changed …）
那件小小的板凳当时逐渐地虚弱。（gradually weak）
保管它的那位邻居在入冬前已经渐渐把它搬过两回。（had gradually carried it）
叔叔做这件事比老屋里任何人都来得逐渐地。（more gradually than …）
在那个月份里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最逐渐地。（the most gradually of all of them）
answers: Gradually, in 1963 the father changed the chair at the door.
Before the September rains the father had gradually changed the chair.
The neighbour who kept it had gradually carried it twice before the winter came.
He changed the chair more gradually than anybody else in the house.
Of all who did it that month, he did it the most gradually of all of them.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 gradually 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Gradually, in 1963 the father changed the chair, and nobody forgot it.
Before the September rains the father had gradually changed the chair.
The chair was gradually weak, or so the letter says.
The neighbour had gradually carried it twice before the winter came.
My mother changed the chair gradually on the same day when nobody else would.
Gradually, the house never forgot that part of the story.
